title: SINAMICS S120 Drive Functions — Cogging Torque Compensation
locator: Section 9.15 cogging torque compensation; slow learning and direction-specific tables
notes: SINAMICS S120-specific function. The manual documents position-dependent compensation tables and a slow-learning procedure, including separate positive/negative direction tables. Parameters and procedures apply only to documented S120 firmware/configurations; do not copy to other drives or use without the applicable safety and commissioning documentation.
